note: Docs UI hardening and spec endpoint. docs_url / redoc_url pages load swagger-ui-dist 5.34.0 and redoc 2.5.4 from unpkg at exact versions with SRI integrity + crossorigin=anonymous (the dead unversioned redoc.standalone.css link is gone), and the embedded OpenAPI JSON is escaped for the <script> context (<, >, &, U+2028, U+2029 as JSON unicode escapes) so a </script> or <!-- in a description or example can no longer break the page or inject markup. Pages are rendered by the new vespera::docs module (swagger_ui_html, redoc_html, escape_json_for_script, SWAGGER_UI_VERSION, REDOC_VERSION). New opt-in vespera!(spec_url = "/openapi.json") (env VESPERA_SPEC_URL) serves the generated (and merged) spec as application/json. docs_url / redoc_url / spec_url must start with / and be distinct (compile error instead of an axum panic at startup).
